svg.title: billing entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Each organization has exactly one billing account with the same id, holding the latest subscription (embedded), the numbered credit period and the credit balances. An organization points to one plan; a subscription points to one plan. An organization has zero or more invoices, credit ledger entries and usage charges; a credit purchase entry points to its invoice. Each agent run in the Transactions schema has at most one usage charge with the same id, created at admission for the organization that admitted it and settled once. Billing events are temporary webhook records.
